items.name: pred-click-1
items.prompt: Four low rounded echolocation knocks from a large alien reef predator under thick ice, accelerating gently toward the last knock. Elastic muted thick-glass-like pulses through water and a steel hull, energy mainly below 1500 Hz, soft underwater echo tail. No dolphin, bird, clock, high crackle, shrill attack, voice or music.

items.name: pred-click-2
items.prompt: Five deep soft hollow echolocation clicks from one six-meter alien aquatic predator, spaced slowly then quicker at the end. Slightly darker and more resonant than dry knocks, muffled through cold water, gentle diffuse tail. No recognizable Earth animal, dolphin, ticking clock, high squeal, speech or music.

items.name: pred-roar-1
items.prompt: A single deep visceral pressure growl from a large cold-blooded alien underwater predator charging, low organic vibration swelling then cutting off into a soft watery tail, small bubbles and water compression. Heard through cold water and submarine steel. No lion, bear, dinosaur movie roar, human scream, engine, speech or music.

items.name: pred-roar-2
items.prompt: One dark low pulsing throatless resonance from an alien reef predator lunging through water, rising pressure with bubbling turbulence, more vibrating body than voice, ends decisively with a smooth short decay. Muffled under ice. No terrestrial animal, cinematic dinosaur, person, motor, explosion or music.

items.name: pred-jaw-1
items.prompt: One heavy alien jaw snapping against thick submarine plating, a dull compact jaw click followed by a short gritty tooth scrape on steel, outside the hull and muffled underwater. Small supporting detail for a separate hull impact, not a giant crash. No bone crunch, chewing, wet gore, bell ringing, voice or music.

items.name: pred-jaw-2
items.prompt: A single broad hard jaw clamp and brief low abrasive teeth drag across submarine steel, slightly more scrape and less snap, filtered by deep water with a soft short tail. No bone breaking, chewing, gore, bell, explosion, human sound or music.

items.name: pred-flee-1
items.prompt: One forceful broad crescent tail stroke through water followed by three low alien chattering clicks rapidly receding into the distance. Cold underwater predator retreat, soft muffled low-end turbulence and smooth fading tail. No squeal, whimper, dolphin, bird, scream, explosion, speech or music.

items.name: pred-flee-2
items.prompt: A sudden dense underwater tail sweep from a large alien reef creature turning away, followed by a brief hollow low clicking rattle that quickly becomes distant and fades. More water movement and fewer clicks, no sharp surface splash. No Earth animal, squeak, whining, explosion, voice or music.
